# A top-level var of funcvar type initialized with an async native function.
# When the var is called from a click handler, the handler wrapper must be
# async and the call site must be awaited.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The click handler wrapper is async because handler's slot color is Async.
grep 'addEventListener.*async function' out/index.html

# The funcvar call site is awaited.
grep 'await handler()' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import api "js:./api"

var handler func() string = api.fetchHello

component main {
    button(text="Run", @click { handler() })
    text(value="hi")
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
